items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Well I started to say Kemba, but he got off too... And Kemba was a straight reader, but he could... He could... But all them boys was out there in the field like me

ctx.x: Well who was the uh... I don't know what his name was, nothing. Who was the other you know kind of straight trumpet man and straight reading guys, couldn't get off much?
Well I started to say Kemba, but he got off too. Well, see, they had to be in them bands like with P. Ron. Willie Edwards was one.
